cedc6d2f: RoboCup is the largest robotics and AI competition in the world. In 2026 the Humanoid League and the Standard Platform League merged into the new Humanoid Soccer League (HSL), and PCMS-HRG entered its Large Division — the tier for robots up to 190 cm and 80 kg — in the Major bracket, competing against university and research laboratory teams.
cffd51ab: Booster K1 robots were provided for the duration. Training ran systematically through the full competition stack: hardware structure and safe handling, development environment and ROS 2 deployment, YOLO inference and visualisation, behaviour-tree decision-making with striker and goalkeeper strategies, then multi-robot communication and cooperative match play — building step by step toward the ability to run a complete humanoid soccer match independently.

f780b643: What the students remember most is everything around the ninety seconds of play: version checks, configuration, network connections, camera and main-program start-up, log inspection, then localisation tests, equipment checks, battery swaps and pitch acclimatisation right before walking on. When a robot fell, lost localisation or a module misbehaved mid-match, they had to read the situation and fix it within the competition's procedures. Humanoid robot soccer is not a technology demonstration — it is software development, system debugging, hands-on engineering and teamwork, all at once.
